SE-1118193.title: Wildfire, Aug 8, 2023
SE-1118193.origin: NCEI Storm Events, as filed by the National Weather Service
SE-1118193.text: Wildfire on Aug 8, 2023 in Maui Leeward West (forecast zone HIZ018, YOUR zone: the address is inside it). Deaths: 102. Injuries: 32. Recorded damage: $5,500,000,000 (about $5500 million).
SE-1118193.quote: A wildfire near Lahaina was reported at 6:40 am HST and was contained within 3 hours. Another fire was reported around 3:30pm and prompted evacuation orders by 4:30 pm. However, power lines downed by the damaging winds closed roads and restricted evacuation routes. Wildfire continued to spread rapidly and quickly became out of control. The Coast Guard rescued people entering the Pacific Ocean who were escaping the fire. They rescued seventeen people including two children and assisted forty survivors on shore. At around 11:52 pm the Hawaii National guard was deployed on Maui as wildfires continued to burn out of control. At 1:20 AM on August 9, over 14,000 customers were without power, and at 5:03 AM, the fire damaged much of the historic banyan tree that was imported to Maui in 1873 from India.

sentences.text: The most significant event on record for your area is the Aug 8, 2023 wildfire near Lahaina, which the record lists with 102 deaths, 32 injuries and $5,500,000,000 in damage.
The record says power lines downed by the damaging winds closed roads and restricted evacuation routes, and the Coast Guard rescued seventeen people who were escaping the fire in the Pacific Ocean.
Earlier, on Jan 22, 2001, a brush fire scorched 800 acres of West Maui, and the highway had to be closed for 7 hours, causing a severe traffic jam.
On Aug 12, 2003, a brush fire scorched about 3000 acres on Molokai, threatening two dozen homes in Hoolehua and destroying a storage shed and a house under construction.
Flooding has also marked the county's history: on Jan 29, 2002, flood waters entered the basement of the Lahaina Hongwanji Mission, with recorded damage of $2,500,000.
On Mar 8, 2021, Hana Highway was closed from Peahi Road near Haiku to Keanae due to flooding, with recorded damage of $14,300,000.
On Jan 27, 2023, flash flooding closed Pulehu Road, South Kihei Road and Piilani Highway, and a firefighter helping to clear flood waters was swept into a storm drain.
Overall, the National Weather Service recorded 200 weather events in Maui County since 2000, including 98 flash floods, 33 heavy rain events and 9 wildfires.

SE-5227611.title: Wildfire, Jan 22, 2001
SE-5227611.origin: NCEI Storm Events, as filed by the National Weather Service
SE-5227611.text: Wildfire on Jan 22, 2001 in MAUI (county HIC009). Deaths: 0. Injuries: 3. No damage figure was recorded.
SE-5227611.quote: A fire burned an 800-acre area of brush in the Cut Mountain section of West Maui between Olowalu and Launiupoko. The fire, spread by strong trade winds, scorched that part of the isle from the 1200-foot level of the mountain down to Honoapiilani Highway that runs along the coast. The highway had to be closed for 7 hours, 1038 to 1740, on the 22nd, causing a severe traffic jam.The blaze had threatened two homes and a piggery, but no damage was reported to these structures. A shed burned to the ground, with a loss of the building and tools, including a few generators, inside the shed. No estimated cost of the loss was available.Many firefighters took part in dousing the flames, with three receiving minor injuries. Four water-bucket carrying helicopters were used in containing the fire as well. The cause of the brush fire was unknown.

SE-5327714.title: Wildfire, Aug 12, 2003
SE-5327714.origin: NCEI Storm Events, as filed by the National Weather Service
SE-5327714.text: Wildfire on Aug 12, 2003 in MAUI (county HIC009). Deaths: 0. Injuries: 4. Recorded damage: $10,000.
SE-5327714.quote: A brush fire scorched about 3000 acres on the isle of Molokai, at one time threatening two dozen homes in the town of Hoolehua. The fire, however, did destroy a family's storage shed with its contents. It also destroyed a house under construction and killed a calf trapped in a corral. The dollar cost of damages was a least $10 thousand. Firefighters from Molokai and Maui fought the blaze over a six-day period, utilizing standard methods and four water-carrying helicopters. Four firemen sustained minor injuries--smoke inhalation and strained backs. The cause of the fire was unknown.

SE-5278605.title: Flash Flood, Jan 29, 2002
SE-5278605.origin: NCEI Storm Events, as filed by the National Weather Service
SE-5278605.text: Flash Flood on Jan 29, 2002 in MAUI (county HIC009). Deaths: 0. Injuries: 0. Recorded damage: $2,500,000 (about $2.5 million).
SE-5278605.quote: Heavy showers and isolated thunderstorms resulted in nine or ten luxury apartments being flooded near the Manele Golf Course on Lanai. In Maui, flood waters entered the basement of the Lahaina Hongwanji Mission. Some homes on Molokai and West Maui were also damaged. However, there were no reports of serious injuries.

SE-938300.title: Flash Flood, Mar 8, 2021
SE-938300.origin: NCEI Storm Events, as filed by the National Weather Service
SE-938300.text: Flash Flood on Mar 8, 2021 in MAUI (county HIC009). Deaths: 0. Injuries: 0. Recorded damage: $14,300,000 (about $14.3 million).
SE-938300.quote: Hana Highway was closed from Peahi Road near Haiku to Keanae in windward East Maui due to flooding. A dam failure in the same area was a possibility as water topped the Kaupakulua Dam upstream from the Haiku and Pauwela communities. The dam survived the downpours, however.

SE-1072875.title: Flash Flood, Jan 27, 2023
SE-1072875.origin: NCEI Storm Events, as filed by the National Weather Service
SE-1072875.text: Flash Flood on Jan 27, 2023 in MAUI (county HIC009). Deaths: 1. Injuries: 0. No damage figure was recorded.
SE-1072875.quote: Flash flooding closed Pulehu Road was above the landfill, South Kihei Road near Kulanihakoi Gulch, and Piilani Highway near Nuu. A firefighter helping to clear flood waters was swept into a storm drain and carried about 800 yards to the ocean at around 1 pm HST. He succumbed to injuries on February 4, 2023.

items.action: Two written NWS flood reports sit within 5 km of your address, and a home on Lahainaluna Road was inundated in 2018. Homeowner's insurance does not cover flooding, and a flood policy can take up to 30 days to start, so consider buying well ahead.

guidance.text: Purchase flood insurance or renew a flood insurance policy. Homeowner’s insurance policies do not cover flooding. It typically takes up to 30 days for a policy to go into effect, so the time to buy is well before a disaster. Get flood coverage under the National Flood Insurance Program (NFIP).
